# ToolGuest

> 26 free, private, ad-free online tools for creators, developers and
> businesses. Every tool runs entirely in the browser: no uploads, no
> account, no tracking. The site is a static site hosted on Vercel.

## Key facts

- Free to use, with no sign-up and no ads.
- Processing happens client-side; input files and text never leave the device.
- 26 tools across text, image, developer, video and creator categories.
- Canonical site: https://toolguest.com/

## Tools

- [AI Humanizer](https://toolguest.com/ai-humanizer): Rewrite AI text so it reads naturally and bypasses detectors.
- [Aspect Ratio Calculator](https://toolguest.com/aspect-ratio-calculator): Resolve 16:9, 4:5, 21:9 dimensions and scale perfectly.
- [Base64 Encoder](https://toolguest.com/base64-encoder): Encode and decode Base64 strings, files and data URIs.
- [Case Converter](https://toolguest.com/case-converter): Switch between sentence, title, camel, snake and kebab case.
- [Color Palette Generator](https://toolguest.com/color-palette-generator): Extract cohesive palettes and generate accessible HEX combos.
- [Creator Calculator](https://toolguest.com/creator-calculator): Estimate RPM, sponsorship rates and monthly ad revenue.
- [Unix Epoch Timestamp Converter](https://toolguest.com/epoch-converter): Convert Unix epoch seconds or milliseconds to human dates and back, with a live clock and five global timezones.
- [Font Changer & Bio Generator](https://toolguest.com/font-changer): Fancy Unicode fonts and aesthetic bios for every social profile.
- [Hash Generator](https://toolguest.com/hash-generator): Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 hashes instantly.
- [HEIC to JPG Converter](https://toolguest.com/heic-to-jpg): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to universal JPG in one click.
- [Image Resizer](https://toolguest.com/image-resizer): Resize, crop and compress images locally at full quality.
- [Invoice Generator](https://toolguest.com/invoice-generator): Build branded, downloadable PDF invoices in under a minute.
- [JSON Formatter](https://toolguest.com/json-formatter): Beautify, minify and validate JSON with instant error pointing.
- [Lorem Ipsum](https://toolguest.com/lorem-ipsum): Generate placeholder paragraphs, words or lists on demand.
- [Markdown to HTML](https://toolguest.com/markdown-to-html): Convert Markdown into clean, copy-ready semantic HTML.
- [Meta Tag Preview](https://toolguest.com/meta-tag-preview): Preview Google, X and Facebook cards before you publish.
- [Password Checker](https://toolguest.com/password-checker): Measure entropy and breach risk without sending a byte anywhere.
- [QR Generator](https://toolguest.com/qr-generator): Create high-resolution QR codes for URLs, WiFi and vCards.
- [Shorts Hook Generator](https://toolguest.com/shorts-hooks): Generate scroll-stopping first-3-second hooks for Shorts & Reels.
- [Text & Code Diff Checker](https://toolguest.com/diff-checker): Compare two blocks of text or code and highlight every change.
- [Thumbnail Downloader](https://toolguest.com/thumbnail-downloader): Download any YouTube thumbnail in max resolution — HD & 4K.
- [Timestamp Link Generator](https://toolguest.com/youtube-timestamp): Create shareable YouTube links that jump to an exact second.
- [URL Slug Generator](https://toolguest.com/url-slug-generator): Convert any title into a clean, SEO-friendly URL slug.
- [Video to Blog](https://toolguest.com/video-to-blog): Turn any video link into a structured, SEO-ready blog article.
- [Word Counter](https://toolguest.com/word-counter): Live word, character, sentence and reading-time statistics.
- [YouTube Transcript](https://toolguest.com/youtube-transcript): Pull accurate, timestamped transcripts from any video in seconds.

## Notes

- Pages are served without a .html suffix; the suffixed URL redirects.
- Each page states its own purpose in its title and description.
